Subject: QBR & Exec Sponsor Alignment — scheduling for ACME Corp

Hi Elisa —

Hope you’re doing well. It’s time to lock in our mid-year QBR for ACME. We’d like to schedule a 60–75 minute session that combines an executive sponsor alignment (VP-level) with a product/technical review so we can:

- Review outcomes and roadmap alignment
- Surface any security/compliance or procurement blockers ahead of renewals
- Agree on success metrics and next steps for H2

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue, Jun 29 — 10:00–11:15
- Wed, Jun 30 — 11:00–12:15
- Thu, Jul 1 — 09:00–10:15

Please confirm which of the above works for your exec sponsor(s) and who from procurement/security should join. I’ve attached a draft agenda (Redwood_QBR_agenda_v1.pdf) — happy to adapt.

Attendees we’d like to include from our side: myself (AE), Nikhil Sharma (SE), Vivek Kulkarni (AM), and Laura Bennett (sales lead). I’ll loop the right folks once we confirm timing.

If it helps, here’s a HubSpot link to the account/deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-12345

Thanks — looking forward to finalizing.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
